verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with AI features (Seer, Autofix), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of model training. Server-side data scrubbing, US/EU data storage location and self-hosting are adjacent privacy controls or user-side workarounds, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.
